_readme: Per-Actor audit index, built cycle 815 to replace expensive ad hoc grepping through STATUS_ARCHIVE.md/queue_archive.md (see LEARNINGS.md cycle 811 + cycle 814's dead-end search). Fields are the LAST cycle number a given audit type was run, or null if never done / not yet backfilled. Update this file in the SAME cycle you run any of these audit types on an Actor -- add/replace the relevant field with the current cycle number and a one-line note. Keys: varied_test (plain filter-combo rotation), enum_audit (checked enum/vocabulary fields for structurally-dead values), unreachable_remedy (checked that a zero-row message's suggested fix is actually reachable), competitor_audit (compared price/features against the named competitor). Dates below are backfilled from cycles 797-814's own summaries (already read this session, not fresh archaeology) -- treat gaps (nulls) as real unknowns, not omissions. Key added cycle 824: count_audit (checked whether an upstream API's total-match count, when surfaced to buyers, is exhaustive rather than an estimate, and whether deep pages are actually reachable).

hacker-news-scraper.note: cycle 823: independently re-verified the tags enum (previously only dated to cycle 291, never re-checked). All 7 tag values (story, comment, poll, ask_hn, show_hn, job, front_page) are real and non-empty live via HN's own Algolia API -- no dead enum values. BUT found and fixed a real bug while cross-checking counts: Algolia's /search (relevance, the DEFAULT sortBy) only computes an EXHAUSTIVE nbHits when a text query anchors the ranking. For the documented 'leave queries empty to browse by tag/date only' pattern on a large-volume tag, /search silently returns an approximate nbHits that overshoots the true count by 3-12x (measured live: tags=ask_hn declared 2,262,034 vs the real 179,272 [12.6x]; tags=show_hn 1,941,371 vs 544,193 [3.6x]; story/comment similarly inflated -- small tags job/poll/front_page stay exact). This number flows straight into the buyer-facing declaredMatches/RUN_SUMMARY/status-message text and the hitPaginationCeiling logic. Fix: when sortBy=='search' (relevance) and the iteration's query is empty, re-derive declaredMatches from a supplementary /search_by_date hitsPerPage=0 call (always exhaustive-accurate for the same tags/filters), falling back to the original number if that call fails. Verified locally (show_hn empty-query case dropped from 1,941,371 to 544,198; normal query+tag case unaffected, single request, 286 declared) and live on the platform post-push (same 544,198 result). Shipped build 0.1.46 (prior build was 0.1.4-era -- versioning jumped because apify push auto-increments per-build, not per source-version bump). check-charges 24/24, check-pricing 24/29/0 drift.

trademark-search-scraper.note: cycle 815: combined office+niceClass+status filters verified against TMview's own live API (server-side AND, 0 mismatches on 3 combos incl. a genuine 0-row rare combo); no bug found cycle 824 count_audit: TMview totalResults/totalPages are self-consistent and uncapped -- two 1-row platform runs gave 'coffee' 25,930/519 pages and 'a' 9,682,228/193,645 pages, both exactly ceil(total/50), so no HN-style inflation. BUT this is the fleet's only count-surfacing Actor with NO depth/reachability guard (no declaredMatches/unreachableMatches in RUN_SUMMARY, walk stops only on page>=totalPages or an empty batch) and we have never walked past ~page 10. See queue task 0-NEXT-824 for the bounded depth-probe recipe. TMview is unreachable direct from this box -- any test must be a platform run. cycle 826: finished the depth probe at the code's real ceiling (maxResults:5000, 100 pages) -- Pushed 5000 results, dataset itemCount 5000, all 5000 applicationNumbers unique. Combined with cycle 825's 60-page/3000-row run, TMview has now survived depth walks up to the Actor's own configurable maximum with zero early-empty-batch refusals. Conclusion: no exhausted-vs-refused guard is needed (refusal never observed) -- shipped the lighter disclosure instead: RUN_SUMMARY (declaredMatches/totalPages/pagesFetched/scanned/delivered/complete/stoppedByCap/error) plus a setStatusMessage when a run stops early due to its own maxResults/cost cap, not TMview. Build 0.1.16.
